observations.behavior: Adds a conditional dependency on the `hotpath` crate with profiling and SQL support, gated behind an opt-in feature flag.
observations.posthog_connection: This could enable performance diagnostics or structured tracing for cohort stream processing without changing runtime behavior unless explicitly enabled.

observations.behavior: Wraps subscriber initialization to optionally include a custom SQL query logging layer that is no-op when disabled.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows optional visibility into database queries during cohort ingestion while preserving compatibility in production builds where this overhead might be undesirable.

observations.behavior: Annotates event dispatching functions with instrumentation attributes; these are no-ops absent the hotpath feature but collect timing data otherwise.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides potential insight into latency distribution of cohort membership updates if activated, though currently inactive by default.

observations.limitations: All tiered changes rely entirely on an opt-in feature; no execution path change occurs without enabling it. No tests demonstrate benefit, only configuration and annotation additions. The patch does not establish systemic risk reduction or broader capability improvement.

review.limitations: All tiered changes rely entirely on an opt-in feature; no execution path change occurs without enabling it. No tests demonstrate benefit, only configuration and annotation additions. The patch does not establish systemic risk reduction or broader capability improvement.
review.reason: Changes are narrowly scoped: adding dependencies, conditional compilation, and profiling annotations. Without activation, they have zero behavioral effect. This fits Tier 1 (maintenance/documentation-like) rather than substantive capability improvements.
review.posthog_relevance: Could support future observability or performance tuning for cohort stream processing, potentially aiding debugging or capacity planning—but currently contributes nothing measurable.
review.uncertainty: The actual utility depends on whether PostHog team activates the `hotpath` feature in production or staging environments; this cannot be inferred from code alone.
